# 3 bed bungalow for sale

> In a lovely location on a site measuring 0.67 acres on the outskirts of Woodford village this property is an ideal starter home for a young couple or retirement home for an older couple. Of Ro-Fab construction and built in the 1970s the house is connected to mains electricity, mains water and to a septic tank on-site. It has oil fired central heating and has double glazed PVC windows installed.

## Fakta
- Typ: bungalow
- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 3 bed
- Energetická náročnost: E1
- Lokalita: Rockhill, Woodford
- Cena: 200 000 €
